Order picker

A powered industrial truck or manually operated equipment used to lift personnel for retrieving or placing items on high storage racks in warehouses.

Definition

A powered industrial truck or manually operated equipment used to lift personnel for retrieving or placing items on high storage racks in warehouses.

Operational example

The order picker enables safe retrieval of products from upper shelves, essential for high-density storage in automated warehouses.
